@MeasureTheory.Measure.map_prod_map.{u_1, u_2, u_3,
    u_4} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α]
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} β] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace.{u_3} γ] {δ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace.{u_4} δ] {f : α → β} {g : γ → δ} (μa : @MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α inst)
  (μc : @MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_3} γ inst_2) [@MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_3} γ inst_2 μc]
  (hf : @Measurable.{u_1, u_2} α β inst inst_1 f) (hg : @Measurable.{u_3, u_4} γ δ inst_2 inst_3 g),
  @Eq.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_4 + 1)}
    (@MeasureTheory.Measure.{max u_4 u_2} (Prod.{u_2, u_4} β δ)
      (@Prod.instMeasurableSpace.{u_2, u_4} β δ inst_1 inst_3))
    (@MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_2, u_4} β δ inst_1 inst_3
      (@MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{u_1, u_2} α β inst inst_1 f μa)
      (@MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{u_3, u_4} γ δ inst_2 inst_3 g μc))
    (@MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{max u_3 u_1, max u_4 u_2} (Prod.{u_1, u_3} α γ) (Prod.{u_2, u_4} β δ)
      (@Prod.instMeasurableSpace.{u_1, u_3} α γ inst inst_2) (@Prod.instMeasurableSpace.{u_2, u_4} β δ inst_1 inst_3)
      (@Prod.map.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} α β γ δ f g) (@MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_3} α γ inst inst_2 μa μc))

@measurable_pi_iff.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {δ : Type u_2} {X : δ → Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α]
  [inst_1 : (a : δ) → MeasurableSpace.{u_3} (X a)] {g : α → (a : δ) → X a},
  Iff (@Measurable.{u_1, max u_2 u_3} α ((a : δ) → X a) inst (@MeasurableSpace.pi.{u_2, u_3} δ X inst_1) g)
    (∀ (a : δ), @Measurable.{u_1, u_3} α (X a) inst (inst_1 a) fun (x : α) => g x a)
